'''Jazen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was station on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Tularan Marsh]] where he refused the orders of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh]] to hold the outpost and instead gave his soldiers the order to pull out in face of danger. Only the arrival of a Republic hero who dealt with every problem the locals had forced him to stay put.<ref name="TOR" />
